nativeRoute: Feishu client native identity + current user GitLab OAuth

loginFlow.steps: 在本组织飞书窗口打开 /projects，复用会话或 /auth/feishu/client 原生验证；本人绑定 GitLab 时完成自身 OAuth。普通远程浏览器不具备飞书原生窗口能力时交付入口与表单草稿。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: 服务端 session cookie；候选源码 __Host-approval-session，Secure/HttpOnly，7 天；CSRF 与一次性 state 为独立门禁。无面向 Skill 的 PAT 登录。
subjectPermission: 页面本人姓名、GitLab 绑定、项目读取与审批人 Maintainer/Owner 预检；cookie 存在不证明权限。
expiryRevoke: 候选 internal/server/server.go 注册 POST /auth/logout；session 7d。handler 实际 revoke/CSRF 与部署需确认后才调用。GET /auth/status 只返回 provider 是否配置（feishu/gitlab），不是用户身份探针。已失效时走飞书原生重新验证，不导出 Cookie/PAT。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
